newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco Salvador mine 1996 output up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Codelco Salvador mine 1996 output up slightly.

text.p: Salvador, the smallest of Chilean state copper company Codelco's four divisions, reported copper production rising to 89,841 tonnes last year from 85,878 tonnes in 1995, said a division spokesman.
Last year's output was slightly higher than than the division's target of 89,756 tonnes, he told Reuters.
The division's Potrerillos smelting and refining complex processed 168,427 tonnes of copper, including Salvador's own output and 78,586 tonnes of copper mined elsewhere in Chile.
